# Carcavelos Daily Brief — Friday, August 7th

**Tiny, glassy start followed by a fun afternoon push.**

**Morning (03:49–11:00):** Expect 0.76–0.8m waves with light NNW winds under 9km/h. This is your golden window—conditions are cleanest between 05:00 and 08:00 when winds drop to 3–5km/h. Swell period sits at a decent 6–7 seconds. Water temp around 20°C.

**Evolution:** Wind gradually builds through mid-morning as temps climb. By 11:00, you're looking at 8km/h gusts and a touch of chop developing.

**Afternoon (12:00–18:00):** NNW wind picks up to 15–16km/h by 14:00, creating some texture but still workable. Waves tick slightly up to 0.78m around 15:00–16:00. This is your secondary window if morning was missed—still fun, just busier.

**Tips:** Go early or go home. Light shortboard in the pre-dawn glass. High tide around midday means better shape on the banks.
